chunks: And by his chain, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Take refuge in God from the well of sorrow.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to take refuge in God from the well of sorrow?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) advises seeking refuge in God from 'al-jubb al-huzn' (the pit of sorrow), a concept deeply valued in Shia spirituality as a state of profound, stagnant grief that hinders spiritual ascent. This supplication serves not merely as comfort but as a preventive measure against the soul's descent into emotional stagnation, emphasizing the need for active spiritual resilience. The imagery of a 'pit' suggests a depth from which one must be rescued, aligning with the Shia emphasis on divine mercy as the ultimate source of emotional and spiritual elevation.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-242 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said, “
Take refuge in God from the well of sorrow.”
